description: Score how well one of the user's CVs matches a job description, with the matching and missing skills and keywords. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user shares a job ad and asks whether they're a good fit or what to add. Returns {result:{score,…}} or a plan gate.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: match_takemeup_cv_to_job
title: Match CV to a job (PRO)
